title: Unconditional implications of the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis
summary: This record identifies published conclusions formerly obtained under RH or GRH whose proofs require only a fixed zero-free half-plane for Dirichlet $L$-functions, with further applications of finite-order Hecke $L$-functions over $\mathbb Q(\sqrt{-3})$. The input is the $7/8$ theorem stated in the recent OpenAI manuscript claiming to prove the quasi-Riemann Hypothesis. We give the uniform analytic deductions explicitly and distinguish them from previously established algebraic and combinatorial results used in the proofs.
